description: The latest KPIs of the user's own projects (users, revenue, MRR, profit): each with kpi_key, label, unit, value and measured_at, the moment it was measured. State that date with the number. Money KPIs (unit usd) need financial_details:read and are otherwise listed in withheld_kpis. Optional slug for one project. ($0.05; API key required)
name: get_project_metrics
title: Get Project Metrics
